questions.prompt: Which Chinese text is traditionally associated with Laozi?
questions.fact: Laozi may never have existed as a single person. To many scholars the text reads like a compilation assembled over generations.

questions.prompt: Which animal group includes lizards, snakes, turtles, and crocodiles?
questions.fact: Birds sit inside this group evolutionarily — a crocodile is more closely related to a bird than it is to a lizard.

questions.prompt: Which sport involves riding ocean waves on a board?
questions.fact: Surfing was central to Hawaiian society long before it was a sport, and it only became an Olympic event in 2021.

questions.prompt: Which band was fronted by Freddie Mercury?
questions.fact: Mercury was born Farrokh Bulsara in Zanzibar, and wrote a six-minute single with no chorus that reached number one twice.

questions.prompt: Which US state is composed entirely of islands?
questions.fact: It is the only US state made entirely of islands, and the only one still growing, as lava adds new land.

questions.prompt: What is volatile computer memory that clears when power is lost?
questions.fact: RAM is wiped the moment power stops. That is why an unsaved document vanishes while a saved one survives on the drive.
